what_it_is.prose: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) is a Miniratna Category-I Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, headquartered at Plot No. 38-39, TSFC Building, Nanakramguda, Hyderabad. Founded in 1970, BDL is India's flagship missile manufacturer and the prime production agency for the Akash Surface-to-Air Missile system, the MR-SAM/LR-SAM (co-developed with Israel Aerospace Industries), the Astra Mk-1 BVRAAM (DRDO-designed), and a portfolio of Anti-Tank Guided Missiles including the Konkurs-M and Invar (license from Russia's KBP Instrument Design Bureau) and the Milan-2T (license from MBDA France). BDL also produces naval munitions including the Varunastra heavyweight torpedo, the TAL lightweight torpedo (with a $14.33 million export order in 2023), and the Counter-Measures Dispensing System (CMDS) for the IAF and Indian Navy. BDL integrates BrahMos canister components for BrahMos Aerospace. As of 31 March 2026, BDL's order book stood at ₹26,176 crore (approximately 10.6x FY26 revenue, up 14% from ₹22,814 crore in March 2025), with FY26 new orders of ₹5,909 crore. For FY26, BDL reported revenue from operations of approximately ₹2,442 crore (down 27% YoY) and PAT of ₹420 crore (down 23% YoY). Q4 FY26 was particularly weak with revenue of ₹480 crore (down 73% YoY) and standalone PAT of ₹113.18 crore (down 58.5% YoY). BDL operates four manufacturing units: Kanchanbagh (Hyderabad), Bhanur (Medak, Telangana), Ibrahimpatnam (Telangana), and Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh). A fifth unit at Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh) was announced in August 2021 with foundation stone laid, but its current status has not been updated in primary sources. In October 2024, BDL CMD Commodore A Madhavarao (Retd) confirmed in an IADB interview that BDL is 'Working on the development of... Counter Drone System' as part of its future roadmap, with a focus on hard-kill solutions. However, as of the BDL products page update on 24 August 2026, no counter-drone system is listed — see Atlas slug cus-060 (Tier C).

deployments_procurement.summary: BDL's order book stood at ₹26,176 crore as of 31 March 2026 (up 14% from ₹22,814 crore in March 2025), with FY26 new orders of ₹5,909 crore. Major programmes in production include the Akash SAM (~₹30,000+ crore aggregate orders across Army/IAF), MR-SAM/LR-SAM (~₹6,000 crore orders across Navy, Army, IAF), Astra Mk-1 BVRAAM for the Su-30MKI, Konkurs-M and Invar ATGMs (~₹5,000 crore lifetime orders), Milan-2T ATGM, Varunastra heavyweight torpedo, TAL lightweight torpedo ($14.33M export 2023), and CMDS. BDL integrates BrahMos canister components. FY26 financial performance was weak: revenue ~₹2,442 crore (down 27% YoY) and PAT ₹420 crore (down 23% YoY), with Q4 FY26 particularly weak (revenue ₹480 crore, down 73% YoY; PAT ₹113.18 crore, down 58.5% YoY).

faq.question: What is BDL's role in the Akash SAM programme?
faq.answer: Bharat Dynamics Limited is the prime production agency for the Akash Surface-to-Air Missile system, with aggregate orders exceeding ₹30,000 crore across the Indian Army and IAF. BDL signed a ₹499 crore contract with the IAF in July 2021 and a ₹3,000+ crore contract with the Indian Army in 2023. BEL produces the Rajendra radar and C4I components, while BDL assembles the missile. The Akash system was battle-proven during Operation Sindoor in May 2025.

faq.question: Why did BDL's FY26 revenue decline 27%?
faq.answer: BDL reported FY26 revenue from operations of approximately ₹2,442 crore (down 27% YoY) and PAT of ₹420 crore (down 23% YoY). Q4 FY26 was particularly weak with revenue of ₹480 crore (down 73% YoY) and PAT of ₹113.18 crore (down 58.5% YoY). The decline reflects execution slippages and revenue timing on large missile contracts. However, the order book stood at ₹26,176 crore (~10.6x FY26 revenue) and FY26 new orders of ₹5,909 crore signal recovery visibility.

faq.question: Does BDL have a counter-drone product?
faq.answer: Not yet. BDL CMD Commodore A Madhavarao (Retd) confirmed in an October 2024 IADB interview that BDL is 'Working on the development of... Counter Drone System' as part of its future roadmap, with a focus on hard-kill solutions. However, as of the BDL products page update on 24 August 2026, no counter-drone system is listed among BDL's product portfolio. The Atlas slug cus-060 (BDL Counter Drone V1) is therefore Tier C with noindex=true until a product is formally launched.
